plan:
SOURCE: The executable path string and arguments list supplied to run_text_utility.
TRUST: Clause 4 permits only the allowlisted executables /usr/bin/printf and /bin/echo.
SINK: Subprocess invocation that executes the chosen utility and yields its standard output.
GUARD: Reject any executable other than /usr/bin/printf or /bin/echo by raising ValueError; pass arguments as a direct vector and disable shell processing.
ORDER: Validate the executable against the allowlist before spawning the process; then run the utility with the arguments vector, capturing stdout.
EFFECT: Return the captured standard output as text and allow process failures to propagate.
END_PLAN
